card.name: Words introducing a quantitative comparison
card.fires_on: Small words just before a measured difference or statistic, such as median, slightly, greater, least, had, or percent. Mostly in results text comparing groups or doses.

modes.label: Degree words
modes.description: Adverbs or comparatives that grade a difference before the value or adjective.
